---
title: "Figure 6. Shared age-associated isoform usage across ovarian cell types"
engine: knitr
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,
                     cache = FALSE, fig.align = "left", out.width = "100%")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ComplexHeatmap); library(circlize); library(grid)
})

DATA_DIR <- file.path("data", "Fig6")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path("figures", "Fig6")
FONT_FAMILY <- "Arial"
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
INPUT_A_DATA <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig6A_shared_DIU_directions.tsv")
INPUT_B_DATA <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig6B_shared_DIU.tsv")
INPUT_D_DATA <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig6D_consequence_associations.tsv")
INPUT_B_TREES <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig6B_trees.rds")

CONFIG_A <- list(total = 302L, colors = c(`Aged Up` = "#D48F5A", `Young Up` = "#C96F9F", 
Opposite = "#8A6FB0"))

CONFIG_B <- list(scale_limit = 1, shared_breaks = c(2, 7), shared_colors = c("#E8EDF2", 
"#3D596C"), direction_colors = c(`Aged Up` = "#D48F5A", `Young Up` = "#C96F9F", 
Opposite = "#8A6FB0"), cell_colors = c(SC = "#3C9277", LEC = "#419D9A", 
BEC = "#3F78B5", TC = "#C58A35", SMC = "#7F9A4B", EPI = "#8A6FB0", 
IC = "#B79B3F"))

CONFIG_D <- list(colors = c(low = "#F2F5F8", high = "#3F78B5", missing = "#C9C9C9"
), maximum = 5.77626410857766)

read_input <- function(file, levels = list()) {
  data <- read.delim(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = "NA")
  for (column in names(levels)) data[[column]] <- factor(data[[column]], levels[[column]])
  data
}
matrix_from_table <- function(data, value, row_id, column_id) {
  rows <- unique(data[order(data$row_order), row_id])
  columns <- unique(data[order(data$column_order), column_id])
  result <- matrix(NA, length(rows), length(columns), dimnames = list(rows, columns))
  result[cbind(data$row_order, data$column_order)] <- data[[value]]
  result
}
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top",
        plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)))
save_panel <- function(name, plot, width, height) {
  draw <- function() if (is.function(plot)) plot() else print(plot)
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
                      width = width, height = height, family = FONT_FAMILY)
  draw(); grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")),
                width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 600, background = "white")
  draw(); grDevices::dev.off()
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

## Shared-CAI directions

CAIs are assessable in at least two cell types and show concordant age-associated usage changes.

```{r}
#| label: Fig6A_shared_DIU_directions
panel <- CONFIG_A
table <- read_input(INPUT_A_DATA, list(direction = c("Aged Up", "Young Up", "Opposite")))
panel$data <- table

p <- ggplot(panel$data, aes(x = 2, y = n, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), colour = "white") +
  annotate("text", x = .5, y = 0, label = paste0("Transcripts\n", panel$total), size = 4) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") + xlim(.5, 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = panel$colors, labels = panel$data$label, drop = FALSE)  +
  theme_void(base_size = 11, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))
save_panel("Fig6A_shared_DIU_directions", p, 6.5, 4.3)
```

## Shared-CAI usage changes

Gray denotes unavailable comparisons. Stars indicate DIU P values: *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001.

```{r}
#| label: Fig6B_shared_DIU
panel <- CONFIG_B
table <- read_input(INPUT_B_DATA, list())
columns <- unique(table[order(table$column_order), c("transcript_id", "transcript_label", "direction", "shared_celltypes")])
trees <- readRDS(INPUT_B_TREES)
panel$panel <- list(matrix = matrix_from_table(table, "delta_usage", "celltype", "transcript_id"),
                    stars = matrix_from_table(table, "stars", "celltype", "transcript_id"),
                    direction = columns$direction, shared = columns$shared_celltypes,
                    labels = columns$transcript_label, ids = columns$transcript_id,
                    scale_limit = panel$scale_limit, row_tree = trees$row, column_tree = trees$column)

p <- panel$panel
effect_col <- colorRamp2(seq(-p$scale_limit, p$scale_limit, length.out = 9),
                         colorRampPalette(c("#C96F9F", "#F7F7F7", "#D48F5A"))(9))
shared_col <- colorRamp2(panel$shared_breaks, panel$shared_colors)
top <- HeatmapAnnotation(Direction = p$direction, `Shared CT` = p$shared,
  col = list(Direction = panel$direction_colors, `Shared CT` = shared_col),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9), annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_param = list(`Shared CT` = list(at = c(5, 6, 7))))
left <- rowAnnotation(CellType = rownames(p$matrix), col = list(CellType = panel$cell_colors),
                      show_annotation_name = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE)
ht <- Heatmap(p$matrix, name = "Delta Usage", col = effect_col, na_col = "#D8D8D8",
  cluster_rows = p$row_tree, row_dend_reorder = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = p$column_tree, column_dend_reorder = FALSE,
  column_labels = p$labels, column_names_rot = 45,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  top_annotation = top, left_annotation = left, use_raster = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c(-1, 0, 1)),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "#E8E8E8", lwd = .3),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill)
    if (nzchar(p$stars[i, j])) grid.text(p$stars[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)))
save_panel("Fig6B_shared_DIU", function() draw(ht,
  merge_legends = TRUE, padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm")), 10, 5.4)
```

## Consequence associations

Color shows −log10(P); stars indicate nominal P < 0.05. Gray denotes unavailable tests.

```{r}
#| label: Fig6D_consequence_associations
panel <- CONFIG_D
table <- read_input(INPUT_D_DATA, list())
panel$matrix <- matrix_from_table(table, "score", "term_id", "consequence_id")
panel$significance <- matrix_from_table(table, "significant", "term_id", "consequence_id")
panel$testable <- matrix_from_table(table, "testable", "term_id", "consequence_id")
panel$term_labels <- setNames(unique(table[order(table$row_order), "term_label"]), rownames(panel$matrix))
panel$column_labels <- unique(table[order(table$column_order), "consequence_label"])

col <- colorRamp2(c(0, panel$maximum), unname(panel$colors[c("low", "high")]))
ht <- Heatmap(panel$matrix, name = "-log10(P)", col = col, na_col = panel$colors[["missing"]],
  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_labels = unname(panel$term_labels), column_labels = panel$column_labels,
  row_names_side = "left", row_names_max_width = unit(75, "mm"),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_rot = 45, rect_gp = gpar(col = "#E8E8E8", lwd = .2),
  use_raster = FALSE, cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill)
    if (isTRUE(panel$significance[i, j])) grid.text("*", x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)))
save_panel("Fig6D_consequence_associations", function() draw(ht,
  padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm")), 12, 7.2)
```
